4:30 p.m. 
 
 
Agenda 
Posted  
Time:  
 
I. Roll Call 
Council President Pro Temp Alberto Rivas Lugo opened the meeting at 4:33pm.. Present at the 
meeting were Councilperson Kazarian, Councilperson Peguero, Councilperson Solano and Council 
President Pro Temp Rivas Lugo.  The meeting had a quorum. 
 
II. Pledge of Allegiance 
Council President Pro Temp Rivas Lugo led the Council in the pledge of allegiance. 
 
 
III. Public Comment 
None 
 
 
IV. New Business 
a. City Council sitting as Board of License Commissioners  
Hearing and Consideration of Petition of License 
License Type  Business Name 
Entertainment 
Per Diem 
 Segue IFL 
325 Cowden Street 
Applicant Nadya Sanchez 
Ms. Nadia Sanchez addressed the Council, providing background on the program and the request. 
She responded to questions and inquiries from Council members. A motion to approve was made by 
Councilmember Kazarian and seconded by Councilmember Peguero. The motion passed 
unanimously, 4–0. 
 
V. Adjournment 
A motion to adjourn was made by Councilmember Peguero and seconded by Councilmember 
Solano. The motion passed, and the meeting adjourned at 4:38 p.m.
